content.en: Researchers are exploring the use of algorithms to improve wideband spectrum sensing in cognitive radio networks. These algorithms, such as sub-Nyquist non-uniform sampling, compressed sensing, and adaptive spectrum sensing, aim to reduce power consumption, improve throughput, and optimize sampling rates. By applying these algorithms, researchers hope to enhance the performance and efficiency of spectrum sensing in cognitive radio systems.
content.da: Forskere undersøger anvendelsen af algoritmer for at forbedre bredbåndsspektrumssensing i kognitive radio-netværk. Disse algoritmer, såsom sub-Nyquist ikke-uniform sampling, compressed sensing og adaptive spectrum sensing, har til formål at reducere strømforbruget, forbedre throughput og optimere samplingrater. Ved at anvende disse algoritmer håber forskerne at forbedre ydeevnen og effektiviteten af spektrumssensing i kognitive radiosystemer.
